location.approximate_site: Santaquin Research & Tech (Summit Data) Center site plan at approximately 1900 S. Frontage Road; local/trade reporting places the Summit Ridge Data Center near I-15 exit 242/Summit Ridge Parkway and at 15372 S. Ridge Farms Road.

contradictions.description: Capacity remains conflicting: Cleanview lists 20 MW; Data Center Dynamics reported 20MW+ on 2026-01-30 (article accessed via Wayback Machine snapshot, web.archive.org/web/20260130151256/...); DataCenterMap lists 100 MW and DCPC publicly corrected DCD coverage to 100 MW+ at full buildout in a LinkedIn comment. No official Santaquin record with MW was located.

Official DRC minutes verify site-plan approval with redline conditions, but third-party DataCenterMap labels the project under construction/full design. KSL and Data Center Dynamics both reported in January 2026 that construction had not begun or no start date was set (DCD article via Wayback Machine snapshot; Fox13Now also reported no groundbreaking date as of yet); no permit/energization record was found.
